_comment: Maps each norm PDF filename (placed in this folder) to its metadata. doc_id in Qdrant is derived as slug(norm_name)_version, so version must change whenever a document is superseded.

documents._verify: No version/date found in the document itself or via web search (checked crsbis.in, meity.gov.in). Covers Phase-I CRS product categories only (15 categories from the 2012 order) — later CRS phases (II-VII) added more categories not covered here.

documents.filename: Public Procurement Policy for Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) Order, 2012.pdf
documents._verify: This is only the original 2012 base order. Confirmed via the official Gazette (S.O. 5670(E), 9 Nov 2018) that a 2018 Amendment Order changed the procurement target from 20% to 25% and added a 3% women-owned-MSE sub-target, effective 1 April 2019 — not yet sourced/ingested as a separate document. See ROADMAP.md.

documents.norm_name: GFR 2017 Chapter 6 (Procurement of Goods and Services)
documents._verify: Full document is 208 pages covering all of government financial management (budgeting, accounts, audit, etc.) -- only Chapter 6 (pages 40-56) is about procurement/Rule 189 two-packet bidding, so only that chapter is ingested. Deliberate scope cut, not a missed page range.

documents.norm_name: DPIIT Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
documents._verify: This PDF renders every line twice for a fake-bold effect; pdfplumber's default extract_text() interleaves both passes character-by-character, doubling every letter ('NNoo..'). use_text_flow=True fixes it -- verified against the raw character stream, not just eyeballed. The 2020-09-15 order (below) only amends specific paragraphs (2,3,5,10,13) of this one -- both stay active simultaneously, neither supersedes the other wholesale.

documents.norm_name: DPIIT Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
documents._verify: Partial amendment of paras 2, 3, 5, 10 & 13 of the 2020-06-04 revision above -- both versions of this norm_name stay active, since this one doesn't replace the whole document.
